name: Lovisa

prices.note: US store (Shopify lovisa-usa, USD). Earrings collection feed: 2564 earrings (backs and tool-only items excluded), 2481 regular price, 83 marked down. Lowest $2.99 (4mm Pearl Stud Earrings, Black Butterfly Enamel Stud Earrings); median $17.99; mid-range e.g. Gold 3D Flower Hoop Earrings $12.99; highest Sterling Silver Flat Edge Hoop $49.99 and Surgical Steel Flat Back Tool & Celestial Earrings Pack $46.99. Homepage promo 'Buy 3+, Save 20%' and bundles (Earrings Bundle 5 for $12) are promotions, not markdowns.

notes: 2026-10-29 (claires page run): www.lovisa.com is the US store (Shopify.shop lovisa-usa, currency USD, country US); lovisa.com.au is the AUD store.

Shipping policy: US standard (3-6 business days) free over $45, else $5.99; express $14.99; next day $24.99. Canada express CAD $16. Refund policy: refunds within 30 days of delivery; online orders can be returned to a Lovisa store; 'Earrings, body piercing products, hair accessories, face masks, and gift cards cannot be returned or exchanged for change of mind reasons.'

Piercing page: 'Our piercing service is free! All you have to do is purchase a piercing stud.' Studs from $34.99 surgical steel, $54.99 nose, $59.99 14KT gold, $129.99 diamonds. Hand-pressurized device with pre-sterilized single-use stud; lobe, upper lobe, stacked lobe, midi, helix, nostril; nose and helix not at every store.

Wikipedia (Lovisa): founded in Sydney in April 2010 (Shane Fallscheer with Brett Blundy's BBRC); HQ Sydney; 1,024 stores in more than 50 countries (July 2025), United States among them. Store locator is script-loaded, so us_stores left empty.
